claims: Arnold Barboza Jr. defeated Kenneth Sims Jr. by a unanimous decision on March 14, 2026, at the Honda Center in Anaheim, California.
Judges scored the fight 117-111, 118-110, and 120-108 in Arnold Barboza Jr.'s favor.
The fight was for the vacant WBO Global Welterweight Title.
The fight was in the welterweight weight class (147 lbs).
Both Arnold Barboza Jr. and Kenneth Sims Jr. moved up from super lightweight.
Arnold Barboza Jr. had a record of 33-1, 11 KOs.
Kenneth Sims Jr. had a record of 22-4-1, 8 KOs.
Arnold Barboza Jr. called out Ryan Garcia and Devin Haney in his post-fight interview, according to Yahoo Sports.
The fight took place on a Golden Boy Promotions card headlined by Arnold Barboza Jr. vs. Kenneth Sims Jr.
Oscar Collazo retained his titles against Jesus Haro, as reported in a YouTube video and on Badlefthook.
